gigapan.description: This Nano Gigapan has two matches side by side illustrating the difference (as seen under a scanning electron microscope) between a unlit strike anywhere match and one that has been burned.  This image is composed of 140 pictures of matches magnified 150x.  Can you tell which has been burned?
